citations.description: Entire held-out test file — no BindingPersistError test present
test_bind_pending_persist_failure_skips_create asserts create_issue not called but not delete_issue not called

findings.criterion: the `BindingPersistError` branch also does not delete, asserted
findings.detail: No test in the held-out file (test_identity_write_retention_heldout.py) covers the BindingPersistError branch at all. The existing test in test_write_ahead_recovery.py (test_bind_pending_persist_failure_skips_create) asserts create_issue.assert_not_called() but never asserts delete_issue is not called. The post-create BindingPersistError case (where record_pending_key fails after create_issue succeeds) is not tested anywhere. The criterion explicitly requires this to be 'asserted'.
findings.remediation: Add a test in test_identity_write_retention_heldout.py that triggers the post-create BindingPersistError (record_pending_key fails after create_issue succeeds) and asserts client.delete_issue is never called. Also add client.delete_issue.assert_not_called() to test_bind_pending_persist_failure_skips_create.

citations.description: Implicit reference to Sentry precedent without naming Sentry or createmeta
Search for 'Sentry' in docs/ and src/ returned no matches; search for 'createmeta' in docs/ and src/ returned no matches

findings.criterion: createmeta pre-flight is explicitly recorded as OUT of scope with the Sentry precedent
findings.detail: The docs/user-guide.md says 'rebar does not discover or populate custom required fields — the supported answer is to add `labels` to those screens (or reconcile a project that already has it), matching the boundary mature Jira integrations draw.' This implicitly references the Sentry precedent but does not name Sentry or 'createmeta' explicitly. The criterion requires the Sentry precedent to be explicitly cited. No search for 'Sentry', 'createmeta', or 'pre-flight' in docs or src returned a match naming Sentry.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit statement in docs/user-guide.md (or an ADR) that names Sentry's Jira integration as the precedent and explicitly records createmeta-driven pre-flight field discovery as out of scope, citing the reason (DC ≥9.0 split endpoints, version-gating complexity, and the retro-attach path already recovering from the failure).
